aiResearchSummary.text: Andromeda Surgical is engaged in research and development of a universal surgical robotic platform, as described in the work titled Universal surgical robotic platform. This system features a processor and a robotic platform designed to interface with procedure-specific end effectors, enabling controlled and adaptable surgical interventions. Their focus is on advancing autonomous robotic systems to enhance consistency and efficiency in surgical procedures.
